decisions.reason: The candidate's existing message-143 INTRODUCE already records the token serial as the referral-code source and on-chain NFT metadata as a display location; no additional change is needed.
Making the token serial visible in NFT metadata does not change how book access, referral identity, badges, or expired tickets behave after an NFT transfer.
The referral-code metadata fields do not alter the requirement to deploy on Base.
The metadata decision does not change the amount, structure, or disclosure of secondary-sale royalties.
Adding the token serial as an on-chain metadata referral-code attribute does not change badge thresholds, award basis, or badge attachment.
The referral-code metadata representation does not change commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, timing, or cap.
The metadata change does not affect the randomness provider, on-chain winner-selection process, verification surface, or applicable draws.
The FAQ requirement already has a message-143 INTRODUCE covering the supplied copy and referral-code topic; the metadata subdecision requires no additional FAQ state change.
The referral-code metadata decision does not change Transak, supported fiat methods, or wallet and cryptocurrency prerequisites.
Adding referral identity to NFT metadata does not change the NFT ebook format or unlimited edition supply.
The metadata representation of the referral code does not change ticket recipients or the Small and Big Block ticket quantities issued for a coded referral mint.
The NFT metadata decision has no effect on the deferred Discord launch condition.
